name: Anvilo
summary: A 29-page factory app with a drag-and-drop production plan and a live line
about: Anvilo runs a small metal works: production plan, work orders, shop floor, machines, maintenance, quality, sales, stock and money in one app. Jobs sit on a machine timeline you drag and resize, and the overview shows the line moving live. Good for manufacturers, workshops and anyone building software for them.
how: Open Production plan and drag a job along the timeline or onto another machine
Drag the right edge of a job to change its length, or focus it and use the arrow keys
Drag a backlog job onto a machine row, or press Auto-schedule backlog
Click a station on the live line to stop it, start it or report a fault
Edit a bill of materials and watch unit cost and margins update
Press Ctrl+K to jump to any of the 29 pages
